title: Why Your Real Competitor Isn't Who You Think
description:
Two totally different products can be fighting for the exact same customer -- because people don't buy products, they hire them for a job. This is the Jobs-to-be-Done lens from Level 1 of the Product Manager Mastery Path, and it explains why your real competition is often not who you'd assume. The full lesson also covers behavioral customer interviews and building personas the right way.

Source lesson:
- https://sigilipelli.github.io/product-manager-mastery-path/level-1/02-understanding-customers-users/

#Shorts

beats.narration: What if your real competitor isn't another app at all?

display.heading: Your Competitor Isn't Who You Think

beats.narration: Jobs-to-be-Done says people don't buy products -- they hire them to make progress on something, in a specific situation.

display.heading: Jobs-to-be-Done
display.subheading: "When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome]."

beats.narration: A paper planner, a phone reminder app, and a full project management tool can all get hired for the exact same job -- making sure you don't forget something important.

display.heading: Same Job, Totally Different Products
display.subheading: Paper planner. Reminder app. Project tool.

beats.narration: That's the real power of JTBD -- it explains why customers jump ship to a product that looks completely different on the surface, which means your real competition often isn't who you'd assume.

display.heading: That's Why Customers Switch
display.subheading: Even to a product that looks nothing like yours
